items.titleZh: 哈达尔将缺席本节练习，明天将与拉塞尔从最后一位发车 #F1 #新加坡大奖赛
items.summaryZh: 哈达尔感谢车队在冲刺赛之后修复了他的赛车，但他现在在赛道上滑行，表示引擎已关闭。
items.originalTitle: Hadjar's out of this session, he'll start at the back alongside Russell tomorrow #F1 #SingaporeGP
items.summaryEn: Hadjar's out of this session, he'll start at the back alongside Russell tomorrow #F1 #SingaporeGPChris Medland: Hadjar thanked his team for getting his car fixed after the Sprint and getting him out on track, but now he's coasting on track saying "The engine is off!" #F1 #SingaporeGP
detailZh: 哈达尔将缺席本节练习，他将在明天与拉塞尔一起从最后一位发车。#F1 #新加坡大奖赛Chris Medland: 哈达尔感谢车队在冲刺赛之后修复了他的赛车，但他现在在赛道上滑行，表示引擎已关闭。#F1 #新加坡大奖赛
detailEn: Hadjar's out of this session, he'll start at the back alongside Russell tomorrow #F1 #SingaporeGPChris Medland: Hadjar thanked his team for getting his car fixed after the Sprint and getting him out on track, but now he's coasting on track saying "The engine is off!" #F1 #SingaporeGP
